CVC Capital Partners (ENXTAM:CVC) has drawn fresh attention after agreeing to buy a 40% stake in Israeli defence group Fibrotex for about €250 million, a transaction handled with uncommon discretion.

The latest Fibrotex deal lands after a tough stretch for CVC Capital Partners’ stock, with the 30 day share price return down 10.54% and the year to date share price return down 12.90%, contributing to a 1 year total shareholder return that has declined 15.88%.
